page: JSON Schema conversion in Zod (introduced zod@4.0). Convert between JSON Schema and Zod schemas. JSON Schema standard widely used in OpenAPI and structured outputs for AI. Functions: z.fromJSONSchema() converts JSON Schema to Zod schema, z.toJSONSchema() converts Zod schema to JSON Schema. Unrepresentable types: bigint, int64, symbol, undefined, void, date, map, set, transform, nan, custom, multipleOf(0). Options for conversion: target version, metadata, unrepresentable handling, cycles, reused schemas, uri, override. Metadata stored in registries with z.globalRegistry. Questions: How to convert JSON Schema to Zod? How to convert Zod to JSON Schema? How to handle cycles? How to customize JSON Schema output? What types can't be represented?

sections.manifest: z.fromJSONSchema() function (experimental - not stable API, likely to change). Converts JSON Schema objects to Zod schemas. Takes JSON Schema with type, properties, required fields. Example: object type with name string and age number properties. Experimental status noted - implementation may change in future releases.

z.toJSONSchema() converts Zod schemas to JSON Schema. Supports JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 (default), Draft 07, Draft 04, OpenAPI 3.0. Parameters interface: target (schema version), metadata (registry for schema metadata), unrepresentable (throw|any|function for unsupported types), cycles (ref|throw), reused (ref|inline), uri (custom $ref URI function). All Zod schema checks convert to closest JSON Schema equivalents. Unrepresentable types include: bigint, int64, symbol, undefined, void, date, map, set, transform, nan, custom, multipleOf(0). Metadata overrides Zod-generated keywords. io parameter selects input or output type representation. override callback modifies generated JSON Schema directly.

Conversion details. String formats: email, iso.datetime (with format date-time), iso.date (format date), iso.duration (format duration), ipv4, ipv6, uuid, guid (format uuid), url (format uri), base64 (contentEncoding). Unsupported string formats use pattern: iso.time, base64url, cuid, emoji, nanoid, cuid2, ulid, cidrv4, cidrv6, mac, currencyCode. Numeric types: z.number() -> type number, z.float32/float64 with exclusiveMinimum/exclusiveMaximum, z.int() -> type integer, z.int32() with exclusiveMinimum/exclusiveMaximum. Object schemas: z.object() has additionalProperties false by default. z.looseObject() never sets additionalProperties false. z.strictObject() always sets additionalProperties false. File schemas: z.file() converts to type string with format binary and contentEncoding binary. File size and MIME checks represented with contentMediaType and minLength/maxLength. Nullability: z.null() becomes type null. z.nullable() adds null to accepted types. z.optional() unchanged, decorated with optional annotation.

Registries for multiple interlinked JSON Schemas. Pass registry to z.toJSONSchema() to output multiple schemas. All schemas must have registered id property. z.globalRegistry methods: add(schema, {id: string}). Default $ref URIs are simple relative paths. uri option converts id to fully-qualified URI. Example: uri function generates https://example.com/{id}.json format. Registries used for organizing complex schema sets across multiple files or servers.
